text:
Maria: heads up — PR #12785 is waiting on approvals but CI is noisy. two runs failed with the snapshot diff on `json_roundtrip`
Devin: I left a review comment about a minor formatting change, but that shouldn't affect the test. pinging @Sanjay for the failing assertions
Sanjay: looking now. I saw this earlier — seems nondeterministic when run with larger batch size on shard-3. might be a race in serialization order
CI Bot: build 12785.2 failed on shard-3 — failed test: json_roundtrip_snapshot
CI Bot: failing assertion:
```
Expected: {"keys": ["a","b"]}
Actual:   {"keys": ["b","a"]}
```
Alice: that log looks like ordering-only; we should tolerate key ordering in the snapshot or normalize before asserting
Jon: agree with Alice. quick options: update test to sort keys, or update snapshot to a canonicalized form. which is faster?
Maria: preference is to canonicalize in the test to avoid repeated updates. short PR change is fine if folks +1 it
Devin: I can push a tiny patch to normalize the map before snapshot. will open a follow-up commit to this PR unless someone wants to do it in the same branch
Sanjay: +1 to normalization. also can we re-run CI for the current PR once tests updated? current rerun queue is long though — asking infra
CI Bot: re-run requested by Devin for PR #12785 (build 12785.3 queued) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria: thanks. if 12785.3 passes we can merge once approvals are in. @Alice @Jon can you approve after the normalization commit?
Alice: will do, will review the tiny patch when it's up :+1:
Jon: same, will approve after commit. if the rerun still flakes we can relax the assert instead of snapshot churn
Maria: great — plan: Devin pushes normalization commit, CI rerun, approvals, merge. keeping this thread for quick status updates
Devin: pushed commit `normalize-json-for-snapshot` to the branch. build 12785.3 started. cc @CI Bot
CI Bot: build 12785.3 passed on all shards — all tests green :tada:
Maria: merging now. thanks everyone for quick turnaround :shipit:
Devin: thx!
